description:
Terracotta Jali Tiles 006 are a square hollow clay jali block with a recessed square centre, shown in the product photo beside a plain wall, for anyone who wants a minimal screen wall rather than an ornate pattern.

## How it looks
Each block in the photo is a square frame with a smaller square set back inside it, so a wall of them reads as a neat grid of framed openings with a little depth and shadow. It is one of the simpler, more architectural designs in the range, and it tends to suit modern houses, plain plaster and exposed brick.

## Where it works
- **Hollow terracotta block wall** for a boundary, terrace edge or parking screen.
- **Minimal jali design** panels on a front elevation where a busy pattern would clash.
- **Recessed square jali block** inserts in a solid wall as ventilation windows for a stair, store or bathroom.

Hollow clay blocks have long been used to let air through walls in hot climates, and terracotta tends to keep its colour without paint.

## Good to know
- Category: terracotta jali
- Shape: square hollow block with a recessed square centre (from the product photo)
- Size and thickness are not listed online yet; confirm them before you plan courses and quantities.

Keep joints even and strike off mortar cleanly so the recessed centres stay crisp. For a tall wall, ask your mason about pillars or reinforcement. Clean with water and a soft brush.

## See it before you order
Visit the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) or G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) with your wall area for a dated quote. Read the [terracotta jali guide](/blog/terracotta-jali-in-pakistan-designs-uses-and-ordering-guide), see [house front wall ideas](/blog/house-front-wall-tiles-design-ideas-stone-and-brick-elevation), or browse the full [terracotta jali range](/categories/terracotta-jali).

faqs.q: What is the price of square hollow clay jali blocks?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the design, the quantity and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Can hollow clay jali be used as a ventilation window?
faqs.a: Yes. A few blocks set into a solid wall are a common way to ventilate stairs, stores and bathrooms while keeping privacy. Keep the openings clear of mortar.

faqs.q: Hollow clay jali or cement breeze block: what is the difference?
faqs.a: Clay jali is fired terracotta with a warm natural colour; cement breeze blocks are grey concrete and are often painted. Both screen and ventilate; the look is the main difference.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "Terracotta Jali Tiles 006" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
